headline: EMRU had its busiest quarter, while three annual outputs have not started

points.title: Environmental investigations up sharply
points.text: EMRU ran 91 investigations in Q3, up from 66 in Q2 and 51 in Q1 — 208 so far in 2026.

points.title: Three outputs have not started
points.text: Basic radiation training (0 of 100), chemical disposal licences (0 of 5) and handler training sessions (0 of 2) are at zero with one quarter left.

points.title: Gbai River selenium 5.9× the limit
points.text: Selenium exceeded 0.01 mg/L at 11 of 13 points below the Yuelliton slide; the Golay River control was 0.005 mg/L.

points.title: CMU answered every application
points.text: All 38 applications were answered in Q3 and 35 regulatory instruments were issued.

points.title: Waste certificates lag behind
points.text: WRU responded to 15 of 17 waste applications in Q3 but issued only 4 certificates.

points.title: Night noise above the limit everywhere
points.text: All 11 night-time readings around the Peuto Dela Torres compound exceeded 55 dBA; the highest was 94.8 dBA.
